scripts.text:
[Guy]
Welcome to the Treasure Hunters Guild {0}.
scripts.translation:
[盖伊]
欢迎来到寻宝猎人公会，{0}。

scripts.text:
[Guy]
Look {0}, you can only 1 quest at a time, you should finish the quest unless you have given up.
Giving up will cost you ^FF00002500z^000000.
scripts.translation:
[盖伊]
听着，{0}，一次只能接一个任务。
除非你打算放弃，否则得先把手头的任务完成。
放弃任务要支付^FF00002500 Zeny^000000。

scripts.text: No, never would I leave a quest!
scripts.translation: 不，我绝不放弃任务

scripts.text: Yah I'm pathetic... Pay 2500z
scripts.translation: 唉，我真没用... 支付 2500 Zeny

scripts.text:
[Guy]
Good well get back out there.
scripts.translation:
[盖伊]
很好，那就继续去完成任务吧。

scripts.text:
[Guy]
Its sad to see someone give a quest up...
Shame on you.
scripts.translation:
[盖伊]
看到有人放弃任务真让人难过...
真丢人。

scripts.text:
[Guy]
Thats sad you don't even have ^FF00002500z^000000.
scripts.translation:
[盖伊]
真惨，你连^FF00002500 Zeny^000000都没有。

scripts.text:
[Guy]
Ahh welcome fellow Treasure Hunter.
You currently have ^FF0000{0}^000000 treasure tokens!!!
Would you like me to assign you a Quest?
scripts.translation:
[盖伊]
啊，欢迎，寻宝猎人同伴。
你现在有^FF0000{0}^000000枚寻宝代币！
要我给你安排一个任务吗？

scripts.text: Yes I would like a Quest Please.
scripts.translation: 请给我一个任务

scripts.text: Sorry Guy no time today.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，盖伊，今天没空

scripts.text:
[Guy]
Ok lets see what quest we can give you today.
The quest names in ^FF0000This Colour^000000 mean that they are more challenging then the rest, but have better rewards.
scripts.translation:
[盖伊]
好，看看今天有什么任务适合你。
名称用^FF0000这种颜色^000000标出的任务比较难，不过奖励也更丰厚。

scripts.text:
[Guy]
Alright maybe next time {0}.
scripts.translation:
[盖伊]
好吧，下次再来吧，{0}。

scripts.text:
[Guy]
I'm afraid you must sign up for the guild before you can go on a quest!
scripts.translation:
[盖伊]
恐怕你必须先加入公会，才能开始任务！

scripts.text:
[Guy]
I'm afraid there aren't any Quests for you yet.
Call in {0} hours later.
scripts.translation:
[盖伊]
目前还没有适合你的任务。
过 {0} 小时再来吧。

scripts.text:
[Guy]
Ok you have a couple quests that can be done here.
scripts.translation:
[盖伊]
好的，这里有几个任务可以接。

scripts.text: Lost Old Man.
scripts.translation: 迷路的老头

scripts.text: Master needs his Bow.
scripts.translation: 师父需要他的弓

scripts.text: The Hit List.
scripts.translation: 通缉名单

scripts.text: ^FF0000The Sad Widow.^000000

[Guy]
^FF0000Lost Old Man^000000
^FF0000------------^000000
This is an easy and low payed quest.
 
A wife came in asking us to find his husband, she seems to come in a lot asking us to find him over and over again.
scripts.translation:
[盖伊]
^FF0000迷路的老头^000000
^FF0000------------^000000
这是个简单的小任务，报酬不高。

一位太太请我们寻找她的丈夫。
她常来这里，一次又一次地让我们帮她找人。

scripts.text:
[Guy]
But he always seems to be around the same place so there isn't much looking involved,check the mountains 1 west and 1 north of Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[盖伊]
不过他总在同一个地方，不用费太多工夫。
从普隆德拉往西走一张地图，再往北走一张地图，去那里的山上看看。

scripts.text:
[Guy]
^FF0000Master needs his Bow^000000
^FF0000--------------------^000000
This is just a package delivery run, no big deal or anything.
 
Take this to an archer in the Archer Village outside of Payon.
scripts.translation:
[盖伊]
^FF0000师父需要他的弓^000000
^FF0000--------------------^000000
这只是一次简单的送货任务，没什么大不了的。
 
请把这个送到斐扬外面的弓箭手村，交给那里的弓箭手。

scripts.text:
[Guy]
^FF0000The Hit List^000000
^FF0000------------^000000
In this quest you get to see some action.
 
There has been a farmer that keeps having all his crops eaten by ^FF0000Thief Bugs, Porings, and Lunatics^000000 here is a lost of what I need you to do. He is waiting East of Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[盖伊]
^FF0000通缉名单^000000
^FF0000------------^000000
这个任务能让你活动活动筋骨。

有位农夫的庄稼总被^FF0000浮勒盗虫、波利和疯兔^000000吃掉。
这是要你消灭的目标名单。
他在普隆德拉东边等你。

scripts.text:
[Guy]
Ok go to the east and bash those little bastards like there is no tomorrow. When you are done with that list you have just discard it, but you will NOT get another one!.
scripts.translation:
[盖伊]
去东边，狠狠收拾那些小混蛋吧。
名单上的目标处理完就可以把名单丢掉，不过我可不会再给你一份！

scripts.text:
^FF0000The Sad Widow^000000
^FF0000*************^000000
This is just another quest with possible well pay.
 
There is an old Widow in Prontera, she recently lost her husband due to a monster attack.She has requested a Guild member to come talk to her at the Prontera Graveyard.
scripts.translation:
^FF0000悲伤的寡妇^000000
^FF0000*************^000000
这又是一个可能报酬不错的任务。
 
普隆德拉有一位老寡妇，她最近因魔物袭击失去了丈夫。她请求公会成员去普隆德拉墓地与她交谈。

scripts.text:
[Guy]
Ok you have a couple quests that can be done here.
scripts.translation:
[盖伊]
好的，这里有几个任务可以接。

scripts.text: The Strange Letter
scripts.translation: 奇怪的信件

scripts.text: Jur for Jeramiah
scripts.translation: 送给杰拉迈亚的刺击拳刃

scripts.text: Bee Keepers Hunny
scripts.translation: 养蜂人的蜂蜜

scripts.text: ^FF0000The Wander Man^000000

^FF0000The Strange Letter^000000
^FF0000------------------^000000
I do not know much about this quest.
 
A strange man came in here yesterday and asked me to deliver this ^FF0000Strange Letter^000000 to some woman in Morocc. Knowing us we do not ask questions so you must take care of this delivery.
The Woman is in located in Morocc and her name is Erika.
scripts.translation:
^FF0000奇怪的信件^000000
^FF0000------------------^000000
我对这个任务也不太了解。

昨天有个奇怪的男人来这里，让我把这封^FF0000奇怪的信件^000000交给梦罗克的一位女士。
你也知道，我们向来不过问，所以这趟就交给你了。
那位女士叫艾丽卡，住在梦罗克。

scripts.text:
^FF0000Jur for Jeramiah^000000
^FF0000----------------^000000
Standard delivery quest.
 
Jeramiah ordered a Special Jur from our weapon shop.Your Job is to deliver it to him in the Assasin Temple.
scripts.translation:
^FF0000送给杰拉迈亚的刺击拳刃^000000
^FF0000----------------^000000
普通的送货任务。

杰拉迈亚在我们的武器店订了一把特制的刺击拳刃。
你把它送到刺客神殿，交给他就行。

scripts.text:
^FF0000Bee Keepers Hunny^000000
^FF0000-----------------^000000
Strange man in the marsh need your help.
 
There is a strange man in the forest in ^FF00001 south and 1 west^000000 of Prontera, he need your help with something.
scripts.translation:
^FF0000养蜂人的蜂蜜^000000
^FF0000-----------------^000000
沼泽里的怪人需要你的帮助。

从普隆德拉往^FF0000南走一张地图，再往西走一张地图^000000，那里的森林中有个奇怪的男人。
他有事需要你帮忙。

scripts.text:
^FF0000The Wander Man^000000
^FF0000**************^000000
There is a woman in Payon that is in desperate for aid.
 
There is a woman in Payon named Molly please get to her as soon as possible the letter she sent here sounded like someone was killing her.
scripts.translation:
^FF0000流浪的男子^000000
^FF0000**************^000000
斐扬有位女士急需帮助。

她叫莫莉，请尽快去见她。
她寄来的信急得像是有人要杀她一样。

scripts.text:
[Guy]
Ok you have a couple quests that can be done here.
scripts.translation:
[盖伊]
好的，这里有几个任务可以接。

scripts.text: Damn Pixies!
scripts.translation: 该死的小妖精

scripts.text: Package Delivery
scripts.translation: 包裹投递

scripts.text: Prontera Culvert
scripts.translation: 普隆德拉下水道

scripts.text: ^FF0000Trouble at the Coal Mine^000000

^FF0000Damn Pixies!^000000
^FF0000------------^000000
Have you ever been to Hell?
 
A man outside of ^FF0000Ant Hell^000000 has requested your audience, I suggest you hurry.
scripts.translation:
^FF0000该死的小妖精^000000
^FF0000------------^000000
你去过地狱吗？

^FF0000蚂蚁地狱^000000外有个男人想见你，最好赶紧过去。

scripts.text:
^FF0000Package Delivery^000000
^FF0000----------------^000000
Standard drop off quest.
 
In this quest you need to deliver a mystery box to someone names ^FF0000Flank at the bridge between Aldebaran and Juno^000000.
scripts.translation:
^FF0000包裹投递^000000
^FF0000----------------^000000
普通的送货任务。

把这个神秘盒子送给^FF0000艾尔帕兰和朱诺之间桥上的弗兰克^000000。

scripts.text:
^FF0000Prontera Culvert^000000
^FF0000----------------^000000
The bugs,They are everywhere!.
 
The ^FF0000Prontera Culvert^000000 is out of control!Sign up as a volunteer to clean out some of the culvert.
scripts.translation:
^FF0000普隆德拉下水道^000000
^FF0000----------------^000000
虫子，到处都是虫子！

^FF0000普隆德拉下水道^000000里的情况已经失控了！
去报名当志愿者，帮忙清理下水道吧。

scripts.text: I know it seems like there is no stopping them but however many you kill does makes a difference. After you have signed up, inside the Culvert there will be a Knight that will give you a quest.
scripts.translation: 虽然看起来它们无穷无尽，但每消灭一只都有意义。报名后，在下水道里你会遇到一位骑士，他会给你发布任务。

scripts.text:
^FF0000Trouble at the Coal Mine^000000
^FF0000************************^000000
The fun...err...trouble never stops in Rune-Midgarts.
 
Recently there was an accident at the coal mines. There was a huge chasm that released some undead Evil Druids.
scripts.translation:
^FF0000煤矿的麻烦^000000
^FF0000************************^000000
在卢恩·米德加兹，乐趣...呃...麻烦从未停止。
 
最近煤矿发生了一起事故。巨大的裂缝中涌出了许多亡灵暗神官。

scripts.text: The Evil Druids started to turn all the workers into the undead. We do not know why, but we do not want to find out, contact a man named Rudolfo outside the Coal Mines.
scripts.translation: 暗神官开始将工人们变成亡灵。我们不知道原因，也不想知道。请去煤矿外找一位名叫鲁道夫的男子。

scripts.text:
[Guy]
Ok you have a couple quests that can be done here.
scripts.translation:
[盖伊]
好的，这里有几个任务可以接。

scripts.text: Zombie Attack
scripts.translation: 腐尸袭击

scripts.text: Mystic Wizard
scripts.translation: 神秘巫师

scripts.text: Aww shoot!
scripts.translation: 哎呀！

scripts.text: ^FF0000Emperium^000000

^FF0000Zombie Attack^000000
^FF0000-------------^000000
The undead have invaded Payon Cave!
 
I remember when Payon Cave used to be a safe place to visit, but now undead Zombies have infested the cave! Please contact ^FF0000Flora outside on Payon Cave^000000 and aid her.
scripts.translation:
^FF0000腐尸袭击^000000
^FF0000-------------^000000
不死者入侵了斐扬洞穴！
 
我记得斐扬洞穴曾经是一个安全的去处，但现在那里已经布满了腐尸！请联系^FF0000斐扬洞穴外的芙罗拉^000000，协助她。

scripts.text:
^FF0000Mystic Wizard^000000
^FF0000-------------^000000
Proto-type of a Staff must be delivered to Zed the Wizard.
 
Zed the Wizard has requested to try out a new un-named proto-type staff. It will be your job to deliver this to him. Zed tend to stay within the general area of Juno.
scripts.translation:
^FF0000神秘巫师^000000
^FF0000-------------^000000
把法杖样品送给巫师泽德。

巫师泽德想试用一款尚未命名的新法杖。
你的任务就是送过去，他通常在朱诺附近活动。

scripts.text:
^FF0000Aww shoot!^000000
^FF0000----------^000000
A little girl is in trouble.
 
There is a little girl in trouble, her name is Dassy and she is ^FF0000east of the Prontera fountain^000000.
scripts.translation:
^FF0000哎呀！^000000
^FF0000----------^000000
一个小女孩遇到了麻烦。
 
有个名叫达西的小女孩遇到了麻烦，她在^FF0000普隆德拉喷泉的东边^000000。

scripts.text:
^FF0000Emperium^000000
^FF0000********^000000
This is a strange quest that I know little about.
 
Someone in ^FF0000Prontera Guild Hall^000000 has requested to see one of our members, his name is Czhore.
scripts.translation:
^FF0000华丽金属^000000
^FF0000********^000000
这是一个奇怪的任务，我知之甚少。
 
^FF0000普隆德拉公会大厅^000000里有人想见我们的成员，他的名字是茨霍雷。

scripts.text:
[Guy]
Ok you have a couple quests that can be done here.
scripts.translation:
[盖伊]
好的，这里有几个任务可以接。

scripts.text: Savage Land
scripts.translation: 荒野之地

scripts.text: Pyramid's part 1
scripts.translation: 金字塔 第一部分

scripts.text: Thinking first
scripts.translation: 三思而后行

scripts.text: ^FF0000The not so friendly ghost^000000
scripts.translation: ^FF0000不太友好的幽灵^000000

scripts.text:
^FF0000Savage Land^000000
^FF0000-----------^000000
Easy for some very hard for others.
 
A man named Lithin wishes to give you a quest, you can find him north of Prontera inside of ^FF0000The Hidden Temple^000000
scripts.translation:
^FF0000荒野之地^000000
^FF0000-----------^000000
有人觉得简单，有人觉得很难。

一个叫莉辛的男人有任务给你。
他在普隆德拉北边的^FF0000隐藏神殿^000000里。

scripts.text:
^FF0000Pyramid's^000000
^FF0000---------^000000
Its funny cause no one knows how these were really made.
 
Apparently the Pyramids have are beginning to be infested with undead activity,outside the pyramids a man will be waiting for you. He did no give us his name but he asked for you to hurry.
scripts.translation:
^FF0000金字塔^000000
^FF0000---------^000000
说来也怪，没人知道这些金字塔究竟是怎么建起来的。

最近里面的不死魔物似乎越来越多了。
入口外有个男人在等你，他没留名字，只说让你赶紧过去。

scripts.text:
^FF0000Thinking first^000000
^FF0000--------------^000000
This sounds like another one of those ditzy girl quests...
 
Dazzy the local blond around Geffen has asked for you to deliver her these flowers. I don't know why someone would send flowers to herself...
scripts.translation:
^FF0000三思而后行^000000
^FF0000--------------^000000
这听起来又是那种迷糊女孩的任务...
 
吉芬当地的金发女子达西请你把这些花送给她。我不知道为什么有人要送花给自己...

scripts.text:
^FF0000The not so friendly ghost^000000
^FF0000*************************^000000
Well no one ever said Casper was nice behind the scenes.
 
A wizard on the 3rd floor of Geffen tower wants to talk to you about the ancient ruins underneath the city.
scripts.translation:
^FF0000不太友好的幽灵^000000
^FF0000*************************^000000
谁知道卡斯珀私底下是不是也那么友善呢。

吉芬塔三楼有位巫师，想跟你谈谈城下的古代遗迹。

scripts.text:
[Guy]
Ok you have a couple quests that can be done here.
scripts.translation:
[盖伊]
好的，这里有几个任务可以接。

scripts.text: Package for thieves
scripts.translation: 给盗贼的包裹

scripts.text: Pyramid's part 2
scripts.translation: 金字塔 第二部分

scripts.text: Special delivery
scripts.translation: 特殊快递

scripts.text: ^FF0000Geffenia^000000

^FF0000Package for thieves^000000
^FF0000------------------^000000
How ironic.
 
Deliver this Box to the Thieves guild.

^FF0000Pyramid's part 2^000000
^FF0000----------------^000000
More undead action in this triangle!
 
Talk to a man outside the entrance of the pyramids, he seems to have another quest for you.
scripts.translation:
^FF0000金字塔 第二部分^000000
^FF0000----------------^000000
这座三角形建筑里，不死魔物又闹起来了！

去找金字塔入口外的那个男人，他似乎又有任务给你。

scripts.text:
^FF0000Special delivery^000000
^FF0000----------------^000000
Well most of what we do is run packages, this is no different from other's.
 
Take this box, DO NOT OPEN IT! To a little girl in Lutie named Chirach she should be around Santa.
scripts.translation:
^FF0000特殊快递^000000
^FF0000----------------^000000
我们大多是在送包裹，这次也不例外。

把这个箱子送给姜饼城的小女孩奇拉克，她应该在圣诞老人附近。
千万别打开！

scripts.text:
^FF0000Geffenia^000000
^FF0000********^000000
The little children of Geffen have been having strange nightmares.
 
We believe that the ruins underneath Geffen are causing this problem, talk to a Wizard named Zuuzuu inside Geffen Tower for your mission.
scripts.translation:
^FF0000吉芬尼亚^000000
^FF0000********^000000
吉芬的孩子们最近总做奇怪的噩梦。

我们怀疑是城下遗迹在作祟。
去吉芬塔找名叫祖祖的巫师接任务。

scripts.text:
[Guy]
Ok you have a couple quests that can be done here.
scripts.translation:
[盖伊]
好的，这里有几个任务可以接。

scripts.text: Apple Juice
scripts.translation: 苹果汁

scripts.text: Delivery
scripts.translation: 快递

scripts.text: ^FF0000Golden Thief Bug^000000
^FF0000Evil Pirates^000000

^FF0000Apple Juice^000000
^FF0000-----------^000000
Can't say no to some good apple juice.
 
There is a little girl up in Prontera Square a bit north from the fountain, go talk to her.
scripts.translation:
^FF0000苹果汁^000000
^FF0000-----------^000000
面对美味的苹果汁，谁都无法拒绝。
 
普隆德拉广场喷泉北边一点有个小女孩，去和她谈谈。

scripts.text:
^FF0000Delivery^000000
^FF0000--------^000000
So many packages so little time.
 
Take this box to a man in Alberta named Charles.
scripts.translation:
^FF0000快递^000000
^FF0000--------^000000
包裹这么多，时间却这么少。
 
把这个箱子送到艾尔贝塔一个叫查尔斯的男人那里。

scripts.text:
^FF0000Golden Thief Bug^000000
^FF0000****************^000000
The Prontera Culvert has never been the same...
 
Well there have been reports of a Golden Thief Bug running around the bottom of the Culvert. Talk to a Knight inside the Culvert.
scripts.translation:
^FF0000黄金虫^000000
^FF0000****************^000000
普隆德拉下水道已经不再是从前的样子了...
 
有报告说下水道底部有一只黄金虫在四处游荡。去下水道里找一位骑士谈谈。

scripts.text:
^FF0000Evil Pirates^000000
^FF0000************^000000
A ghost ship has washed up on shore on an island outside of Izlude.
 
A female assassin has a quest for you, she is waiting outside the Ghost Ship. There have been reports of evil undead pirates lurking around inside the ship.
scripts.translation:
^FF0000邪恶海盗^000000
^FF0000************^000000
一艘幽灵船被冲到了依斯鲁得附近一座岛屿的岸上。

船外有位女刺客等着你，她有任务要交给你。
据说船里潜伏着邪恶的不死海盗。

scripts.text:
[Guy]
Ok you have a couple quests that can be done here.
scripts.translation:
[盖伊]
好的，这里有几个任务可以接。

scripts.text: Banana Juice
scripts.translation: 香蕉汁

scripts.text: Another Delivery
scripts.translation: 又一次送货

scripts.text: My lost beeds
scripts.translation: 丢失的玻璃珠

scripts.text: ^FF0000Baphomet!^000000

^FF0000Banana Juice^000000
^FF0000------------^000000
Sound gross to some good to others.
 
There is a little girl up in Prontera Square a bit north from the fountain, go talk to her.
scripts.translation:
^FF0000香蕉汁^000000
^FF0000------------^000000
有人觉得难喝，有人却觉得美味。

普隆德拉广场喷泉往北一点有个小女孩，去跟她谈谈。

scripts.text:
^FF0000Another Delivery^000000
^FF0000----------------^000000
Well yah box delivering is in high demand,lots of lazy people.
 
Take this package to a man in Morocc named Klye.
scripts.translation:
^FF0000又一次送货^000000
^FF0000----------------^000000
懒人太多，送包裹的生意可火了。

把这个包裹送给梦罗克一个叫克莱的男人。

scripts.text:
^FF0000Baphomet!^000000
^FF0000*********^000000
Hidden in the Temple he watches and guards.
 
Rumor has it that a Goat Man is lurking in the Hidden Temple, There is also a man in the Hidden Temple names Zack that needs you help with this Goat Man known as Baphomet.
scripts.translation:
^FF0000巴风特！^000000
^FF0000*********^000000
他隐藏在神殿中，监视并守护着那里。

传闻在隐藏神殿中潜伏着一只山羊人。那里还有一位名叫扎克的男子，他需要你的帮助来对付这只被称为巴风特的山羊人。

scripts.text:
^FF0000My lost Beeds^000000
^FF0000-------------^000000
Oh great I smell stupidity...
 
A little girl in Payon wants to talk to you, her name is Flower, What a stupid name,Hahaha.
scripts.translation:
^FF0000丢失的玻璃珠^000000
^FF0000-------------^000000
得，又是一桩蠢事...

斐扬有个叫花儿的小女孩想见你。
这名字真傻，哈哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Guy]
Ok you have a couple quests that can be done here.
scripts.translation:
[盖伊]
好的，这里有几个任务可以接。

scripts.text: Smelly Box
